# Velimir Paleksic

> Main hub for graphic design, YouTube thumbnail design, business websites, and direct project contact.

## Key links

- [Homepage](https://velimirpaleksic.com/): Main entry page and service overview.
- [Graphic design hub](https://design.velimirpaleksic.com/): Graphic design portfolio, services, and brief.
- [Thumbnail design hub](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/): Thumbnail portfolio, pricing, proof, and brief.
- [Websites hub](https://dev.velimirpaleksic.com/): Website offers, pricing, live work, and case studies.
- [Contact hub](https://contact.velimirpaleksic.com/): Email, project-type starters, and path selection.

## Contact

- Email: business@velimirpaleksic.com
- Best contact page: [Contact hub](https://contact.velimirpaleksic.com/)

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer the dedicated hubs for pricing, proof, and portfolio details.
- Use the main hub for high-level positioning and navigation only.
